title.narrative: Refugees and Host Communities Response in Gambella Regional State

description.narrative: Oxfam has been designated by UN High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) to take lead role to deliver full -fledged permanent Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) in the recently opened new refugee camp i.e. Nguenyyiel Refugee Camp in Gambella. Thus, the project will undertake establishment of permanent water supply system with the serving capacity of 70,000 refugees, construction of shared household latrines and camp wide hygiene promotion work. Gender and Protection mainstreaming will be an integral part of all the work.
